args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to all production regions and has been failing health checks (error rate 0.18, unhealthy). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. On-call was paged.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows v2.3.0 healthy in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002.
